title: Inca Bridge Qeswachaka
short_description: An essential tour to discover one of Cusco’s most unique cultural wonders.
long_description:
MORNING: 04:30 AM – ENDS 18:00 PM
Discover the last Inca suspension bridge still handwoven today: Q’eswachaka. A unique cultural experience that connects tradition, living history, and the stunning landscapes of southern Cusco.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets, and professional guide.

seo_description: Discover the Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge, the last traditional handwoven Inca suspension bridge. Full-day tour from Cusco including transport, entrance tickets, and professional guide.

days.title: Day 1
days.text: We will leave early from Cusco toward the province of Canas, passing through beautiful Andean landscapes, highland lagoons, and traditional villages. Upon arriving at Q’eswachaka, you will admire the suspension bridge, over 28 meters long, hanging above the Apurímac River—a place full of history, symbolism, and energy. You will have time to explore the surroundings, take unforgettable photos, and learn more about Andean worldview and the cultural value of this heritage. An ideal experience for travelers seeking to connect with the living tradition of the Andes.
